Name: Pretty Anime Rasmodia
Author: SerDakota
Description:
A female Wizard overhaul to be used with Romanceable Rasmodia. It just touches the portraits and does nothing else on its own. I have also included special portraits for her 8 heart event provided by WerewolfMaster's and PaintedParrot's version because it seemed fun lol. Each festival comes with a static portrait that can be toggled off with GMCM. These are static so you do lose out of the different expressions based on heart levels these mods normally provide.

[b]FOR THE PRETTY ANIME RASMODIA RASMODIUS VERSION YOU MUST SET PORTRAITS TO CUSTOM IN GMCM OR IT WILL BREAK!!!![/b]

If you would like matching portraits you may find them [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38134]here [/url]with Genderbent versions [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45307]here[/url]. Be sure to DISABLE the Wizard portraits in the GMCM if you use them or it will BREAK!!!! 

There is also built in support for DDFCScaler which can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44971]here[/url]. Highly recommended so you may adjust portrait size to your likely. 

[b][u]These were created with the use of Ai.[/u][/b]
